A fair comparison

01 /

Fit on train

25,380 official trials. Train-only scaling and model updates. No random dataset splits.

02 /

Select on dev

24,844 trials. Select hyperparameters, checkpoints and operating thresholds before evaluation.

03 /

Evaluate once frozen

71,237 trials. Report EER, accuracy, ROC and attack-level results with seed spread.

FROM WAVEFORM TO EVIDENCE

Listen. Transform. Examine.

Lightweight Spectrogram-Based Deepfake Audio Detection for Secure Authentication.

01 / INPUT

One shared front end

Mono, 16 kHz audio. A four-second center crop or zero padding keeps comparisons consistent. Corrupt, silent and very short clips are explicitly rejected.

02 / FEATURES

Two views of speech

MFCC statistics and their derivatives feed the classical models. A 64-bin log-Mel spectrogram preserves time-frequency structure for MobileNetV2.

03 / OUTPUT

A transparent decision

A continuous bona fide score is compared with a threshold chosen on dev. Scores are model-specific and are not calibrated probabilities.

What this project can tell you

It tests whether audio resembles bona fide or spoofed examples under the ASVspoof 2019 Logical Access setting. Performance on new generators, languages, microphones or compressed audio can differ.

The extra local TTS set is a separate spoof-only generalisation probe. It supports detection-rate reporting, but cannot provide EER without genuine comparison recordings.

GETTING STARTED

Your lab, on your laptop.

Open PowerShell in the project folder and start the local website:

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe web_server.py

Then visit http://127.0.0.1:8765. Completed model runs appear automatically. Keep training in a separate terminal:

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/run_all.py --resume

The hosted site previews the interface. Actual Torch/SVM inference runs through the local Python app. No model is simulated while training is pending.
